rule: Stability evidence only (owner, 13.11.2026): the real kit balances with the published controller, so a grid value is ruled out only where the loop is unstable at every combination the stated ranges allow (the other unsourced grid values, and the sourced parameters at their values and at every corner of their ranges). Each bound is the span of the admitted grid values widened to the next grid value outward; the wider of the bounds with the answer's own delays and with none is used. Never evidence of a margin.
